parameters.machine_model: JD130S-24-HA40; GMN 6009 front pair / 6007 rear pair; 12 DOF
parameters.healthy_error_definition: approximate user reference; direction unspecified; conditional E_dir calibration
parameters.parameter_status: mixed A/B/C/D; approximate machine mass, catalogue reference and explicit assumptions
parameters.fit_parameter_status: Kf inherited; Df=2*.02*sqrt(.1*Kf); c_h=2um assumed, not measured

excitation.source: V8 verified calibrated U; frozen unchanged for V9 mechanism A

materials_reference_only.note: Do not additionally fit these into Keq already equivalent-fitted; curvature unknown.

parameter_provenance.observation: z_m=.165m rotor section relative fixed ground/probe approximation; E_dir retains 1X
parameter_provenance.excitation_status: conditional healthy calibration; not measured residual unbalance

constitutive_domains.status: small-angle screen only; real contact pressure and high-speed preload validity not established
constitutive_domains.removed_legacy_limits: F2/R1 1um linear tangent limits and 2delta0 strength proxy do not apply to new nonlinear branches

processing.method: centered FIR convolution once on whole guarded signal after resample_poly; -6dB nominal cutoff

sensitivity.note: One at a time; first screen then simulate most sensitive. Not a real-machine confidence interval.

healthy_supports.name: healthy_rear_R1
healthy_supports.domain_basis: Demo local tangent: excursion <=10% of inherited 9.98um normal overlap; not proof of actual healthy assembly contact
healthy_supports.linear_origin: P0=0 N, r0=0 m, fixed for all gaps

excitation.source: unset before healthy calibration; only U is fitted; force ceiling 30 N at 7000 rpm

health_result.note: 等效偏心是U除以指定质量，不是动态轴心幅值；独立冷启动属于数值复核，不是独立实机验证。

legacy_calibration.note: Conditional V6 health calibration retained as the experiment-A U source; not a measured residual unbalance.

v9_acceptance.source_traceability: CRC32 and field comparison; no SHA256 per user rule

scope: 12-DOF static equilibrium, force assembly and two-turn backend replay; no long experiment matrix

metrics.outer_reaction_sign_convention: support balances actual outer contact (-outer restoring), so reaction is +outer restoring

metrics.closure: common structural ring damping, gated by at least one dual-contact ball

limitations: This is numerical integration validation under the supplied conditional configuration, not machine validation.
The two-turn trajectory checks the short backend path only; it is not a steady-state acceptance window.
